title: Supersymmetry, Supergravity and the Consistency of On-Shell Massive Superamplitudes
summary: I study constraints from consistent complex factorisation of $2\rightarrow 2$ scattering amplitudes in $4d$ and their relationship with supersymmetry. I complete the argument demonstrating that a massless helicity-$3/2$ particle must be a gravitino in a theory of supergravity and derive the structure and couplings of massive supermultiplets from first principles. For massive BPS particles in theories with extended supersymmetry, further constraints on the couplings are derived from consistent factorisation of massive superamplitudes.
